note: Parapet backdrop cut from assets/castle.jpg by tools/parapet_scene.py. Device px = image px of castle.jpg (1920x1080 on a 960x540 CSS screen at DPR 2). Every plane is 16 CSS px wider than the screen on each side: place each plane container at left:-16px, top:0, 992x540 CSS, and translate it horizontally only. All numbers below are CSS px inside the plane. Stacking (back to front): clouds, castle-base, castle-top, lit-windows, lake-shimmer, fg-left + fg-right.

clouds.note: Two copies of the picture side by side in a wrapper that slides translateX(0 -> -loopCss) and repeats, by whole device px.

planes.name: clouds
planes.note: opaque, 2 pixels per CSS px: 1:1 on a DPR 2 screen; the second copy overlaps the first by 1 CSS px

planes.name: castle-base
planes.note: opaque; the lake mist and the night fade are baked in

planes.name: castle-top
planes.note: alpha: the light of the sky, the moon's disc and glow, the silhouette, the mountains; its last 8 CSS px fade over castle-base

planes.name: lit-windows
planes.note: opacity 0 at rest; windows.json for the wave

planes.name: lake-shimmer
planes.note: Ambiance vivante only; not in the DOM when it is off

moon.note: screen CSS px at rest (plane offset already removed); it is in castle-top

logo-shadow.webp.note: static element under the focused logo; animate only its opacity (and the same transform as the logo)

lake-shimmer.note: two ripple phases of the lake reflections, normal blend over the castle plane (child of it, so it follows its parallax). Living ambience only: a at opacity 1, b cross-fading 0..1..0 over ~4 s, or b alone 0..0.85..0 over the original.

lake-mist-tile.webp.note: the lake mist (960 CSS px wide), also baked at .13 into castle-base, seamless horizontally: lay two side by side in one strip of 1920 CSS px, translateX(0 -> -960px) linear infinite, 120 s or slower

mist-wake.webp.note: head at the right; trails the rider, fades by opacity and drifts a few px by transform
